reason: This is a broad refactor in core planner infrastructure: it moves `physical schema producer` and touches plan building, optimization, cost, task selection, plan cache clone/rebuild, PB conversion, and index resolution across `pkg/planner/core`. Even if intended as a package move, the blast radius is high for schema propagation and physical-plan correctness, so it is worth a 20–40 minute deep review for Blocker/High issues.
